extensions.reducedMotion: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce collapses all animation/transition durations to 0.001ms, forces .reveal visible, and disables the figure transition; the arc renders pre-drawn and pointer parallax is not bound.

components.css: .ds-procedure{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,0.72fr) minmax(0,1.28fr);gap:clamp(1.2rem,3vw,3rem);align-items:center;padding:clamp(1.4rem,3vw,2.4rem) 0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule);transition:transform 0.42s var(--ease-out);font-family:var(--grotesk);} .ds-procedure:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid var(--rule);} .ds-procedure:hover{transform:perspective(900px) rotateY(-2.4deg) translateZ(10px);} .ds-procedure__diagram{display:block;aspect-ratio:16/10;background:var(--plate-raised);border:1px solid var(--rule);} .ds-procedure__no{font-family:var(--mono);font-size:var(--micro);color:var(--cobalt);letter-spacing:0.06em;} .ds-procedure h3{margin:0.4rem 0 0;font-size:clamp(1.25rem,2vw,1.62rem);font-weight:700;line-height:1.06;letter-spacing:-0.022em;}

components.name: Scroll-snap Carousel
components.description: Shared scroll-snap carousel: an overflow-clipped, scrollbar-hidden track of full-width slides advanced by bordered ghost buttons with keyboard (arrows/Home/End) and native swipe. Two bearers — the photographic registry (Lámina 05) frames a 3:2 crop per slide with tick dots (detail slides re-view the same photograph at scale via --zoom/--ox/--oy); the testimonios registry (Lámina 06) shows one record card per slide with a mono nn/NN counter. Controls collapse when only one slide exists.

narrative.overview: The page is a printed anatomical-atlas plate, not a website. Its organizing device is the numbered lámina (01–07): every section is a plate with a mono caption header carrying its name and code, laid on a cold laboratory ground crossed by an SVG measurement reticle, a ruler edge, range arcs, and leader-line annotations. The offer is presented the way a movement study is presented — manikin, arc, tick, measurement — so that occupational therapy reads as instrumented and precise rather than soft. The world is deliberately cold and clinical: a three-step laboratory plate with hairlines doing the work that cards and ambient shadow usually do. Three material voices carry meaning — wood in the named 3D manikin, cobalt in arcs and actions, vermellón only on the active element. All figure, arc, reticle, and pictogram geometry is authored in CSS/SVG; nothing imitates a photograph.
keyCharacteristics: Cold laboratory plate in three tonal steps, structured by hairline rules rather than bordered cards and ambient shadow.
Numbered láminas (01–07) with mono caption codes as the page's index and identity.
Three material voices only: wood (the figure), cobalt (arcs and actions), vermellón (active element alone).
Instrumented feel: measurement reticle, ruler, range arcs, annotation leader lines and ticks.
CSS-authored geometry throughout; the reflection of the plate itself is a signature mechanism.

rules.name: The Active-Only Vermellón Rule
rules.body: Vermellón (#e8451f) appears only on the element that is active or in error. Its entire value is scarcity; if it is not marking the live point, it does not appear.

rules.name: The Cold-Plate Rule
rules.body: The ground is a cold laboratory plate (#eeeef0) with three tonal steps. The warm cream/paper ground typical of wellness pages is refused — the world is instrumented, not cozy.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Bricolage Grotesque speaks; Martian Mono only codes, counts, numbers, and stamps. Mono never sets running prose, and the grotesque never sets a plate code.

rules.name: The Micro Floor Rule
rules.body: No functional text falls below 0.76rem (~12px) — the --micro floor the build honors for captions, tags, and hints.

rules.name: The Numbered-Lámina Rule
rules.body: Every section is a numbered plate with a mono caption code, and those numbers are the navigation. New sections extend the plate series (08, 09…), they do not become unnumbered blocks.

rules.name: The Measure-Band Rule
rules.body: Running body prose occupies roughly 65–72ch. The hero lede (a 58ch column-bound measure) and the three-up steps (39ch) are declared column-bound deviations of their containers, not a global maximum — do not read them as a house line-length rule.

rules.name: The Flat-Plate Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Shadow appears only as a response to state (hover lift, focus, the floating action) or as modeled material inside the figure — never as ambient elevation on cards.

rules.name: The Plate-Reflection Rule
rules.body: The figure and its arc are returned by the plate below as a mirrored, clipped, blurred reflection (.fig-mirror, opacity 0.3, scaleY(-1) with a masked falloff). This is a signature mechanism of the world and is expected on the hero figure; it is never duplicated as a generic content treatment.

rules.name: The Two-to-Four Rule
rules.body: Corners are 2–4px. Interactive and flat surfaces never exceed it, never square off to 0 where the world uses 3px, and only the modeled figure, the logo, and the mobile floating action may go fully round.

dos: Do keep the ground on the cold plate (#eeeef0) and reach for the three tonal steps for layering; treat the measurement reticle as structure, not decoration.
Do number every section as a lámina with a mono caption code (Two-to-Four Rule corners, 2–4px).
Do let cobalt be the only action color; reserve vermellón (#e8451f) for the single active or invalid element.
Do author figures, arcs, ticks, and pictograms as CSS/SVG geometry with 1px hairlines, and keep body prose within ~65–72ch.
Do honor prefers-reduced-motion — reveal, arc draw-on, and pointer parallax all flatten and the reflection stays put.
donts: Don't use warm cream or paper grounds, or reintroduce the pastel rounded-card wellness look the world rejects.
Don't add ambient card shadows or lift surfaces that are not responding to state (Flat-Plate Rule).
Don't use vermellón as a fill, background, or decoration — it marks only the live point.
Don't set running prose in Martian Mono, or drop any functional label below 0.76rem.
Don't exceed 4px on a flat interactive corner, and don't square those corners to 0.
